name: Morse code
description: Every character with a Morse code: A to Z, 0 to 9, punctuation, prosigns like SOS and SK, and accented letters, 94 cards with a memory hook each. Uses the Morse code card type, which comes along.
author: Joao Henrique Costa Araujo

decks.name: Morse code
decks.description: International Morse code, from Wikipedia's table of ITU-R M.1677-1 and the common extensions.

decks.name: Morse code::Punctuation
decks.description: The ITU signs, plus ! & ; _ and the dollar sign, which aren't in the standard.

decks.name: Morse code::Prosigns
decks.description: Procedure signals: letters run together with no gap, drawn with a bar on top.

decks.name: Morse code::Accented letters
decks.description: Letters with diacritics. Several share one code.

types.name: Morse code
types.description: See a character, tap it out in dots and dashes; checked by script, then the right code blinks back. Handles prosigns and codes up to nine elements.

fields.name: letter
fields.description: The letter, digit, sign or prosign to send.

fields.name: name
fields.description: What it's called, shown under it (Full stop, End of contact). Optional.

fields.name: prosign
fields.description: Draw it with a bar on top: a prosign is sent as one run, with no gap between its letters.

fields.name: mnemonic
fields.description: A memory hook, shown after answering.

template.html:
Tap it out
{{letter}}
{{#name}}
{{name}}
{{/name}}

fields.mnemonic: a-**BOUT**: short, long.
**BEAU**-ti-ful-ly: one long, three short.
**CO**-ca **CO**-la: long short long short.
**DAN**-ger-ous: long, short, short.
Eh: one blip. The most common letter gets the shortest code.
fu-ri-**OUS**-ly: short short, long, short.
**GOOD GRA**-vy: long long short.
hip-pi-ty-hop: four quick hops.
i-vy: two quick ones.
jee **WHIZ WHIZ WHIZ**: one short, three long.
**KAN**-ga-**ROO**: long short long. Alone, K also means *go ahead*.
le-**GIS**-la-tor: short, long, short short.
**MM**: two long hums.
**NAV**-y: long, short. A flipped.
**O**h-oh-oh: three long tones. The other half of SOS.
a **PO-LICE**-man: short, long long, short.
**GOD SAVE** the **QUEEN**: long long short long.
ro-**TA**-tion: short long short.
**S**ss: three quick hisses. Half of SOS.
**TALL**: one long tone. The second most common letter gets the other one-element code.
un-i-**FORM**: short short long.
da-da-da-**DUM**: Beethoven's Fifth opens with V.
the **WHITE WHALE**: short, long long.
**X** marks the **SPOT**: long short short long.
**YEL**-low **YO-YO**: long, short, long long.
**ZIG-ZAG**-ging-ly: long long, short short.
One dot, then dashes to fill five.
Two dots, then dashes to fill five.
Three dots, then dashes to fill five.
Four dots, then one dash to fill five.
Five dots: the halfway point, all short.
One dash, then dots to fill five. 6 is 1 flipped.
Two dashes, then dots to fill five. 7 is 2 flipped.
Three dashes, then dots to fill five. 8 is 3 flipped.
Four dashes, then a dot. 9 is 4 flipped.
Five dashes: all long.
A three times: short long, short long, short long.
